Elam.name: Kindattu
Elam.note: His army took Ur and ended the Third Dynasty of Ur.
Elam.note_zh: 其军队攻陷乌尔，终结乌尔第三王朝。

people.name: Puzur-Inshushinak
people.known_for: Last king of the Awan dynasty, who briefly made Elam a great power and used the Linear Elamite script.
people.known_for_zh: 阿万王朝末代国王，一度使埃兰成为强国，并使用线形埃兰文字刻写铭文。

check.n: Dates very uncertain; Wikipedia gives death c. 2110 BC, not 2080 BC.
check.n_zh: 年代极不确定；维基百科作约前2110年卒，而非前2080年。

people.name: Kindattu
people.known_for: Elamite king of Shimashki whose forces sacked Ur around 2004 BC.
people.known_for_zh: 西马什基王朝的埃兰国王，约公元前2004年其军队攻陷并洗劫乌尔。

Elam.name: Hutelutush-Inshushinak
Elam.name_zh: 胡特卢图什-因舒希纳克

people.name: Untash-Napirisha
people.known_for: Elamite king who built the great ziggurat of Chogha Zanbil and a new religious city around it.
people.known_for_zh: 埃兰国王，修建了恰高·占比尔大神庙塔及其周围的宗教城市。

people.name: Napir-Asu
people.known_for: Queen of Untash-Napirisha, known from her life-size bronze statue, a masterpiece of ancient metal casting.
people.known_for_zh: 温塔什-纳皮里沙的王后，她的真人大小青铜像是古代金属铸造的杰作。

people.name: Shutruk-Nakhunte
people.known_for: Elamite king who sacked Babylon and carried the stele of the Code of Hammurabi to Susa.
people.known_for_zh: 埃兰国王，洗劫巴比伦，把《汉谟拉比法典》石碑运回苏萨。

people.name: Shilhak-Inshushinak
people.known_for: Elamite king who campaigned deep into Mesopotamia and left many building inscriptions at Susa.
people.known_for_zh: 埃兰国王，深入两河流域作战，在苏萨留下大量建筑铭文。

Media.name: Deioces
Media.note: Founder of the Median kingdom according to Herodotus.
Media.note_zh: 据希罗多德记载为米底王国的建立者。

check.n_zh: 中文维基载在位约前675年—前653年（或说前678年—前625年）。

Elam.name: Teumman
Elam.note_zh: 在与亚述的战斗中阵亡。

people.name: Zoroaster
people.known_for: Prophet who founded Zoroastrianism; his dates are much disputed and many scholars place him centuries earlier.
people.known_for_zh: 琐罗亚斯德教的创始人，其生卒年代争议很大，不少学者认为更早数百年。

people.name: Deioces
people.known_for: First king of the Medes in Herodotus' account, said to have built the capital Ecbatana.
people.known_for_zh: 希罗多德所记米底第一位国王，据说修建了都城埃克巴坦那。

people.name: Cyaxares
people.known_for: Median king who allied with Babylon to destroy Nineveh in 612 BC and end the Assyrian Empire.
people.known_for_zh: 米底国王，与巴比伦联合于公元前612年攻陷尼尼微，灭亡亚述帝国。

people.name: Astyages
people.known_for: Last king of the Medes, overthrown by his grandson Cyrus the Great in 550 BC.
people.known_for_zh: 米底末代国王，公元前550年被外孙居鲁士大帝推翻。

people.name: Teumman
people.known_for: Elamite king whose defeat by Ashurbanipal at the Ulai River opened the way to the fall of Elam.
people.known_for_zh: 埃兰国王，在乌莱河之战中败于亚述巴尼拔，埃兰从此走向灭亡。

Achaemenid Empire.name: Cyrus II
Achaemenid Empire.note: Cyrus the Great, founder of the empire.
Achaemenid Empire.note_zh: 即居鲁士大帝，帝国的建立者。

people.name: Cyrus the Great
people.known_for: Founder of the Persian Empire, who conquered Media, Lydia and Babylon and let the exiled Jews go home.
people.known_for_zh: 波斯帝国的建立者，征服米底、吕底亚和巴比伦，允许被掳的犹太人返回故土。

people.name: Darius I
people.known_for: King who organised the empire into satrapies, built royal roads and began Persepolis.
people.known_for_zh: 波斯国王，把帝国划分为行省，修建御道，开始兴建波斯波利斯。

people.name: Xerxes I
people.known_for: King who led the great invasion of Greece in 480 BC and completed much of Persepolis.
people.known_for_zh: 波斯国王，公元前480年率大军入侵希腊，并完成波斯波利斯的大部分建筑。

people.name: Harpagus
people.known_for: Median noble who went over to Cyrus and later conquered the Greek cities of Ionia for him.
people.known_for_zh: 米底贵族，投靠居鲁士，后来为他征服了爱奥尼亚的希腊城邦。

people.name: Mardonius
people.known_for: Persian commander of the war against Greece, killed at the Battle of Plataea in 479 BC.
people.known_for_zh: 波斯对希腊战争的统帅，公元前479年在普拉提亚战役中阵亡。

people.name: Artemisia I of Caria
people.known_for: Queen of Halicarnassus who commanded ships for Xerxes at the Battle of Salamis.
people.known_for_zh: 哈利卡纳苏斯女王，在萨拉米斯海战中为薛西斯指挥舰队。

people.name: Scylax of Caryanda
people.name_zh: 卡里安达的斯库拉克斯
people.known_for: Greek explorer sent by Darius I down the Indus River and across the sea to Egypt.
people.known_for_zh: 希腊探险家，受大流士一世派遣沿印度河而下，再经海路到达埃及。

people.name: Cyrus the Younger
people.known_for: Persian prince who hired Greek soldiers to seize the throne and died at Cunaxa in 401 BC.
people.known_for_zh: 波斯王子，雇佣希腊士兵争夺王位，公元前401年战死于库纳克萨。

people.name: Darius III
people.known_for: Last Achaemenid king, defeated by Alexander at Issus and Gaugamela and murdered by his own satrap.
people.known_for_zh: 阿契美尼德王朝末代君主，在伊苏斯和高加米拉败于亚历山大，后被部下杀害。

Empire of Alexander.name: Alexander the Great
Empire of Alexander.note: King of Macedon from 336 BC; ruled Persia from 330 BC.
Empire of Alexander.note_zh: 公元前336年起为马其顿国王，公元前330年起统治波斯。

Seleucid Kingdom.name: Seleucus I Nicator
Seleucid Kingdom.note_zh: 公元前311年起为巴比伦总督。

people.name: Seleucus I Nicator
people.place_zh: 底格里斯河畔塞琉西亚
people.known_for: General of Alexander who won the eastern half of his empire and founded the Seleucid dynasty.
people.known_for_zh: 亚历山大的部将，夺得帝国东半部，建立塞琉古王朝。

people.name: Apama
people.place_zh: 底格里斯河畔塞琉西亚
people.known_for: Sogdian noblewoman married to Seleucus I; many cities named Apamea honour her.
people.known_for_zh: 粟特贵族女子，塞琉古一世的王后，许多名为阿帕梅亚的城市以她命名。

people.name: Peucestas
people.known_for: Macedonian satrap of Persis who learned Persian and adopted Persian dress, winning local support.
people.known_for_zh: 马其顿人，任波斯省总督，学习波斯语、穿波斯服装，赢得当地人支持。

people.name: Eumenes of Cardia
people.known_for: Greek secretary of Alexander who fought the Wars of the Successors and was betrayed after the battle of Gabiene in Iran.
people.known_for_zh: 亚历山大的希腊秘书，参加继业者战争，在伊朗加比埃内战役后被出卖处死。

people.name: Patrocles
people.known_for: Seleucid general and geographer who explored the Caspian Sea for Seleucus I and Antiochus I.
people.known_for_zh: 塞琉古王朝的将领和地理学家，为塞琉古一世和安条克一世考察里海。

Parthian Empire.name: Arsaces I
Parthian Empire.note_zh: 阿尔沙克王朝的创立者。

Parthian Empire.name: Artabanus IV
Parthian Empire.note: Last Parthian king, killed by Ardashir I.
Parthian Empire.note_zh: 安息末代君主，被阿尔达希尔一世所杀。

people.name: Mithridates I of Parthia
people.known_for: King who took Media and Mesopotamia from the Seleucids and turned Parthia into an empire.
people.known_for_zh: 安息国王，从塞琉古王朝手中夺取米底和两河流域，使安息成为帝国。

people.name: Mithridates II of Parthia
people.known_for: Parthian king of kings in whose reign Han envoys reached Parthia and Silk Road trade grew.
people.known_for_zh: 安息国王，在位期间汉朝使者到达安息，丝绸之路贸易兴盛。

people.name: Surena
people.known_for: Parthian general whose horse archers destroyed the Roman army of Crassus at Carrhae in 53 BC.
people.known_for_zh: 安息将领，公元前53年在卡莱战役中以骑射手全歼克拉苏率领的罗马军队。

people.name: Pacorus I
people.known_for: Parthian crown prince who overran Roman Syria and Judea before falling in battle in 38 BC.
people.known_for_zh: 安息王储，曾攻占罗马的叙利亚和犹太地区，公元前38年战死。

people.name: Musa of Parthia
people.known_for: Roman-born queen who ruled Parthia with her son Phraates V, one of the few women to reign there.
people.known_for_zh: 生于罗马的安息王后，与其子弗拉特斯五世共治，是少数执政的安息女性之一。

people.name: Isidore of Charax
people.known_for: Geographer who described the caravan road across the Parthian Empire station by station.
people.known_for_zh: 地理学家，逐站记述了横贯安息帝国的商路。

people.name: Vologases I
people.known_for: Parthian king who fought Rome over Armenia and won a settlement placing his brother on its throne.
people.known_for_zh: 安息国王，与罗马争夺亚美尼亚，最终使其弟登上亚美尼亚王位。

Sasanian Empire.name: Peroz I
Sasanian Empire.note_zh: 在与嚈哒的战争中阵亡。

Sasanian Empire.name: Yazdegerd III
Sasanian Empire.note: Last Sasanian king, killed at Merv.
Sasanian Empire.note_zh: 萨珊末代君主，死于木鹿。

people.name: Shapur I
people.known_for: King of kings who defeated three Roman emperors and captured Valerian in 260.
people.known_for_zh: 萨珊国王，三败罗马皇帝，260年俘虏罗马皇帝瓦勒良。

people.name: Mani
people.known_for: Prophet who founded Manichaeism, a religion that later spread from Rome to China.
people.known_for_zh: 摩尼教的创始人，该教后来从罗马一直传播到中国。

people.name: Kartir
people.known_for: Powerful Zoroastrian high priest who persecuted other faiths and left rock inscriptions about his career.
people.known_for_zh: 权势显赫的琐罗亚斯德教大祭司，迫害其他宗教，并留下记述其生平的摩崖铭文。

people.name: Shapur II
people.known_for: King crowned before birth who reigned seventy years and won back Armenia and Mesopotamian forts from Rome.
people.known_for_zh: 据说未出生即被立为王，在位七十年，从罗马手中夺回亚美尼亚和两河流域要塞。

people.name: Mazdak
people.known_for: Religious reformer who preached sharing of property and was put to death under Kavad I.
people.known_for_zh: 宗教改革家，主张财产共有，在卡瓦德一世时被处死。

people.name: Khosrow I
people.known_for: King famed as Anushirvan the Just, who reformed taxes and the army and welcomed scholars to his court.
people.known_for_zh: 号称“公正者”，改革税制和军队，延揽学者，使萨珊王朝达到鼎盛。

people.name: Borzuya
people.known_for: Court physician of Khosrow I who brought the Indian Panchatantra to Persia and translated it.
people.known_for_zh: 库思老一世的御医，把印度的《五卷书》带回波斯并译成中古波斯语。

people.name: Bahram Chobin
people.known_for: General who defeated the Turks and then seized the throne for a year before Khosrow II returned.
people.known_for_zh: 萨珊名将，击败突厥人后篡位称王一年，后被库思老二世击败。

people.name: Barbad
people.known_for: Court musician of Khosrow II, remembered as the father of Persian music.
people.known_for_zh: 库思老二世的宫廷乐师，被誉为波斯音乐之父。

people.name: Rostam Farrokhzad
people.known_for: Sasanian commander killed at the Battle of al-Qadisiyyah, which opened Iran to the Arab conquest.
people.known_for_zh: 萨珊军队统帅，在卡迪西亚战役中阵亡，此战为阿拉伯人征服伊朗打开了大门。

people.name: Peroz III
people.known_for: Son of the last Sasanian king who sought Tang help to restore Persia and died in Chang'an.
people.known_for_zh: 萨珊末代君主之子，向唐朝求援复国未成，死于长安。

people.name: Abu Muslim
people.known_for: Persian leader of the Abbasid revolt in Khorasan, later killed on the orders of Caliph al-Mansur.
people.known_for_zh: 在呼罗珊领导阿拔斯革命的波斯人，后被哈里发曼苏尔下令杀害。

people.name: Ibn al-Muqaffa
people.known_for: Persian writer who translated Middle Persian books into Arabic and founded Arabic literary prose.
people.known_for_zh: 波斯裔作家，把中古波斯语著作译成阿拉伯语，开创阿拉伯散文文学。

people.name: Bashshar ibn Burd
people.known_for: Blind poet of Persian descent who opened a new, freer style of Arabic poetry.
people.known_for_zh: 波斯裔盲诗人，开创了更为自由的阿拉伯语新诗风。

people.name: Sibawayh
people.known_for: Persian grammarian who wrote the first full grammar of the Arabic language.
people.known_for_zh: 波斯裔语法学家，写出第一部完整的阿拉伯语语法著作。

people.name: Ja'far ibn Yahya
people.known_for: Vizier of Harun al-Rashid from the Persian Barmakid family, whose sudden fall became legend.
people.known_for_zh: 出身波斯巴尔马克家族的哈伦·拉希德宰相，其突然失势成为著名传说。

people.name: Ali al-Rida
people.known_for: Eighth Shia imam, buried at Mashhad, now Iran's holiest shrine.
people.known_for_zh: 什叶派第八伊玛目，葬于马什哈德，其陵墓是伊朗最神圣的圣地。

people.name: Al-Fadl ibn Sahl
people.known_for: Persian vizier who guided al-Ma'mun to victory in the civil war against his brother al-Amin.
people.known_for_zh: 波斯裔宰相，辅佐马蒙在内战中战胜其兄艾敏。

people.name: Tahir ibn Husayn
people.known_for: General who took Baghdad for al-Ma'mun and then founded the Tahirid dynasty in Khorasan.
people.known_for_zh: 为马蒙攻下巴格达的将领，后在呼罗珊建立塔希尔王朝。

people.name: Babak Khorramdin
people.known_for: Leader of the Khurramite revolt in Azerbaijan, which held out against the caliphate for twenty years.
people.known_for_zh: 阿塞拜疆胡拉米派起义的领袖，抗击哈里发军队达二十年之久。

people.name: Ya'qub ibn al-Layth
people.known_for: Coppersmith from Sistan who built the first Persian-led state of the Islamic era and favoured Persian at court.
people.known_for_zh: 出身锡斯坦铜匠，建立了伊斯兰时代第一个波斯人主导的国家，在宫廷提倡波斯语。

people.name: Bayazid Bastami
people.known_for: Early Persian Sufi master famous for his ecstatic sayings about union with God.
people.known_for_zh: 早期波斯苏菲派大师，以论述与真主合一的狂喜言论著称。

people.name: Abu Bakr al-Razi
people.known_for: Physician and chemist who first described smallpox and measles as separate diseases.
people.known_for_zh: 医学家和化学家，最早把天花和麻疹区分为两种不同的疾病。

people.name: Istakhri
people.known_for: Persian geographer whose maps and descriptions covered every province of the Islamic world.
people.known_for_zh: 波斯地理学家，其地图和记述涵盖伊斯兰世界各个行省。

people.name: Abd al-Rahman al-Sufi
people.known_for: Astronomer at the Buyid court whose star catalogue contains the first recorded mention of the Andromeda Galaxy.
people.known_for_zh: 白益王朝的天文学家，其星表最早记录了仙女座星系。

people.name: Adud al-Dawla
people.known_for: Greatest Buyid ruler, who united Iran and Iraq and built hospitals, libraries and dams.
people.known_for_zh: 白益王朝最杰出的君主，统一伊朗和伊拉克，兴建医院、图书馆和水坝。

people.name: Miskawayh
people.known_for: Buyid official, historian and moral philosopher whose ethics drew on Aristotle.
people.known_for_zh: 白益王朝官员、历史学家和伦理哲学家，其伦理学说吸收了亚里士多德思想。

people.name: Ferdowsi
people.known_for: Poet who spent some thirty years writing the Shahnameh, the national epic of Iran.
people.known_for_zh: 诗人，花约三十年写成伊朗民族史诗《列王纪》。

people.name: Mahmud of Ghazni
people.known_for: Sultan who raided India seventeen times and made Ghazni a centre of Persian poetry and learning.
people.known_for_zh: 伽色尼苏丹，十七次远征印度，使加兹尼成为波斯诗歌和学术中心。

people.name: Abu Sa'id Abu'l-Khayr
people.known_for: Persian Sufi master known for short mystical quatrains and for organising the first Sufi lodges.
people.known_for_zh: 波斯苏菲派大师，以神秘主义四行诗闻名，最早组织苏菲修道院。

people.name: Unsuri
people.known_for: Poet laureate at the court of Mahmud of Ghazni, master of the Persian panegyric ode.
people.known_for_zh: 伽色尼马哈茂德宫廷的桂冠诗人，波斯颂诗的大家。

people.name: Avicenna
people.known_for: Physician and philosopher whose Canon of Medicine was a standard textbook in Europe and Asia for centuries.
people.known_for_zh: 医学家和哲学家，其《医典》数百年间是欧亚各地的标准医学教科书。

Ghaznavid Emirate.name: Mas'ud I
Ghaznavid Emirate.note: Lost Khorasan to the Seljuks at Dandanaqan in 1040.
Ghaznavid Emirate.note_zh: 1040年在丹丹坎战役中败于塞尔柱人，失去呼罗珊。

people.name: Alp Arslan
people.known_for: Seljuk sultan who defeated the Byzantines at Manzikert in 1071 and opened Anatolia to the Turks.
people.known_for_zh: 塞尔柱苏丹，1071年在曼齐刻尔特击败拜占庭，为突厥人打开了安纳托利亚的大门。

people.name: Nizam al-Mulk
people.known_for: Persian vizier of the Seljuks for thirty years who founded the Nizamiyya colleges.
people.known_for_zh: 辅佐塞尔柱苏丹三十年的波斯宰相，创办尼扎米亚学院。

people.name: Nasir Khusraw
people.known_for: Persian poet, traveller and Ismaili missionary who described his journey to Egypt and Mecca.
people.known_for_zh: 波斯诗人、旅行家和伊斯玛仪派传教士，记述了他前往埃及和麦加的旅程。

people.name: Abu'l-Fadl Bayhaqi
people.known_for: Ghaznavid secretary whose vivid history of Sultan Mas'ud is a classic of Persian prose.
people.known_for_zh: 伽色尼王朝的文书官，他对苏丹马苏德时代的生动记述是波斯散文经典。

people.name: Omar Khayyam
people.known_for: Mathematician who solved cubic equations and reformed the calendar, also famous for his quatrains.
people.known_for_zh: 数学家，研究三次方程并参与修订历法，又以四行诗闻名于世。

works.title: Treatise on Demonstration of Problems of Algebra

people.name: Hassan-i Sabbah
people.known_for: Founder of the Nizari Ismaili state, who seized the fortress of Alamut in 1090.
people.known_for_zh: 尼扎里派伊斯玛仪国家的创建者，1090年夺取阿拉穆特堡。

people.name: Al-Ghazali
people.known_for: Theologian who reconciled Sufism with orthodox Islam and criticised the philosophers.
people.known_for_zh: 神学家，使苏菲主义与正统伊斯兰教相调和，并批评哲学家。

works.title: The Revival of the Religious Sciences

people.name: Sanai
people.known_for: Ghazni poet who first used the Persian masnavi for Sufi teaching.
people.known_for_zh: 加兹尼诗人，最早用波斯语叙事诗体阐述苏菲思想。

people.name: Anvari
people.known_for: Court poet of Sultan Sanjar, counted among the greatest Persian panegyrists.
people.known_for_zh: 桑贾尔苏丹的宫廷诗人，被视为最伟大的波斯颂诗诗人之一。

people.name: Nizami Ganjavi
people.known_for: Poet whose five long romances, including Layla and Majnun, shaped Persian narrative verse.
people.known_for_zh: 诗人，其包括《蕾莉与马杰农》在内的五部长篇叙事诗奠定了波斯叙事诗的传统。

people.name: Attar of Nishapur
people.known_for: Sufi poet and pharmacist whose allegory of the birds seeking their king is a classic of mysticism.
people.known_for_zh: 苏菲派诗人兼药剂师，其讲述群鸟寻找鸟王的寓言诗是神秘主义经典。

people.name: Fakhr al-Din al-Razi
people.known_for: Theologian and philosopher who wrote a vast commentary on the Quran.
people.known_for_zh: 神学家和哲学家，著有卷帙浩繁的《古兰经》注释。

Ilkhanate.name: Abu Sa'id
Ilkhanate.note: The Ilkhanate broke apart after his death.

people.name: Ata-Malik Juvayni
people.known_for: Mongol official who wrote the history of Genghis Khan and his heirs, later governor of Baghdad.
people.known_for_zh: 蒙古官员，撰写成吉思汗及其子孙的历史，后任巴格达长官。

people.name: Nasir al-Din al-Tusi
people.known_for: Astronomer who built the Maragheh observatory for Hulagu and devised the Tusi couple.
people.known_for_zh: 天文学家，为旭烈兀修建马拉盖天文台，提出“图西双轮”。

people.name: Saadi Shirazi
people.known_for: Poet of Shiraz whose moral tales in verse and prose are among the most loved books in Persian.
people.known_for_zh: 设拉子诗人，其韵文和散文道德故事是最受喜爱的波斯语作品之一。

people.name: Qutb al-Din al-Shirazi
people.known_for: Astronomer and physician of Maragheh who gave the first correct explanation of the rainbow.
people.known_for_zh: 马拉盖天文台的天文学家和医生，最早正确解释了彩虹的成因。

people.name: Rashid al-Din Hamadani
people.known_for: Vizier of the Ilkhans who compiled the first history of the whole known world.
people.known_for_zh: 伊儿汗国宰相，主持编写了第一部涵盖当时已知世界的通史。

people.name: Ghazan
people.known_for: Ilkhan who converted to Islam and reformed taxes, coinage and the postal system.
people.known_for_zh: 伊儿汗，皈依伊斯兰教，改革税收、货币和驿站制度。

people.name: Safi-ad-din Ardabili
people.known_for: Sufi master of Ardabil whose order later became the Safavid dynasty.
people.known_for_zh: 阿尔达比勒的苏菲派长老，他创立的教团后来发展为萨法维王朝。

people.name: Hamdallah Mustawfi
people.known_for: Ilkhanid official who wrote a history and a geography of Iran.
people.known_for_zh: 伊儿汗国官员，著有伊朗史和伊朗地理志。

people.name: Khwaju Kermani
people.known_for: Poet of romances and lyrics whose style influenced Hafez.
people.known_for_zh: 爱情叙事诗和抒情诗诗人，其风格影响了哈菲兹。

people.name: Obeid Zakani
people.known_for: Satirist whose tale of the mouse and the cat mocked the rulers and clergy of his day.
people.known_for_zh: 讽刺作家，其《猫与鼠》嘲讽当时的统治者和宗教人士。

people.name: Hafez
people.known_for: Lyric poet of Shiraz whose ghazals are the most beloved poetry in Persian.
people.known_for_zh: 设拉子的抒情诗人，其加扎勒诗是波斯语中最受喜爱的诗歌。

people.name: Shah Ni'matullah Wali
people.known_for: Sufi master and poet who founded the Nimatullahi order, still active today.
people.known_for_zh: 苏菲派大师和诗人，创立至今仍存在的尼马图拉教团。

people.name: Shah Rukh
people.known_for: Son of Timur who ruled from Herat for forty years and received envoys from Ming China.
people.known_for_zh: 帖木儿之子，以赫拉特为都城统治四十年，与明朝互派使节。

people.name: Goharshad Begum
people.known_for: Wife of Shah Rukh who sponsored the great mosque at Mashhad and a mosque and college complex in Herat.
people.known_for_zh: 沙哈鲁之妻，出资修建马什哈德大清真寺和赫拉特的清真寺与学院建筑群。

people.name: Hafiz-i Abru
people.known_for: Court historian of Shah Rukh who also took part in Timurid embassies.
people.known_for_zh: 沙哈鲁的宫廷史官，曾参与帖木儿王朝的外交活动。

people.name: Baysunghur
people.known_for: Timurid prince whose Herat workshop produced a famous illustrated Shahnameh.
people.known_for_zh: 帖木儿王朝王子，他在赫拉特主持的书坊制作了著名的《列王纪》插图本。

people.name: Sharaf al-Din Ali Yazdi
people.known_for: Historian whose Book of Victory is the official history of Timur's campaigns.
people.known_for_zh: 历史学家，其《胜利之书》是官方编撰的帖木儿征战史。

people.name: Jami
people.known_for: Poet and Sufi of Herat, often called the last great classical Persian poet.
people.known_for_zh: 赫拉特的诗人和苏菲学者，常被称为最后一位古典波斯大诗人。

people.name: Uzun Hasan
people.known_for: White Sheep ruler who conquered most of Iran and sought European allies against the Ottomans.
people.known_for_zh: 白羊王朝君主，征服伊朗大部，并寻求欧洲盟友对抗奥斯曼帝国。

people.name: Jalal al-Din Davani
people.known_for: Philosopher of Shiraz whose book on ethics was widely read in Iran and India.
people.known_for_zh: 设拉子的哲学家，其伦理学著作在伊朗和印度广为流传。

people.name: Mirkhvand
people.known_for: Herat historian whose history of the world was widely copied in the Persian world.
people.known_for_zh: 赫拉特的历史学家，其世界史在波斯语世界广为传抄。

people.name: Sultan Husayn Bayqara
people.known_for: Last great Timurid ruler, whose court in Herat was a centre of poetry and painting.
people.known_for_zh: 帖木儿王朝最后一位有作为的君主，其赫拉特宫廷是诗歌和绘画的中心。

people.name: Kamal ud-Din Behzad
people.known_for: Greatest Persian miniature painter, head of the royal library workshops in Herat and Tabriz.
people.known_for_zh: 最杰出的波斯细密画家，先后主持赫拉特和大不里士的皇家画坊。

Safavid Empire.name: Abbas III
Safavid Empire.note: A child; Nader held the real power.
Safavid Empire.note_zh: 幼主，实权在纳迪尔手中。

people.name: Ismail I
people.known_for: Founder of the Safavid dynasty, who made Twelver Shia Islam the religion of Iran.
people.known_for_zh: 萨法维王朝的建立者，定十二伊玛目什叶派为伊朗国教。

people.name: Sultan Mohammad
people.known_for: Leading painter of the Tabriz school, chief artist of the Shahnameh of Shah Tahmasp.
people.known_for_zh: 大不里士画派的领军画家，《塔赫马斯普列王纪》的主要画师。

people.name: Abbas the Great
people.known_for: Shah who rebuilt the army, beat the Ottomans and Uzbeks and made Isfahan a splendid capital.
people.known_for_zh: 萨法维国王，重建军队，击败奥斯曼和乌兹别克人，把伊斯法罕建成华美的都城。

people.name: Allahverdi Khan
people.known_for: Georgian-born general of Abbas I who reformed the army and built the Si-o-se-pol bridge.
people.known_for_zh: 阿拔斯一世的格鲁吉亚裔将领，参与军队改革，修建三十三孔桥。

people.name: Baha al-Din al-Amili
people.known_for: Scholar, mathematician and architect at the court of Abbas I, known as Sheikh Bahai.
people.known_for_zh: 阿拔斯一世宫廷的学者、数学家和建筑师，人称谢赫·巴哈伊。

people.name: Mir Damad
people.known_for: Philosopher who founded the School of Isfahan, joining Avicenna's thought with Shia theology.
people.known_for_zh: 哲学家，伊斯法罕学派的创始人，把伊本·西那哲学与什叶派神学相结合。

people.name: Mir Emad Hassani
people.known_for: Master calligrapher whose nastaliq script set the standard for later Persian calligraphy.
people.known_for_zh: 书法大师，其波斯体书法成为后世波斯书法的典范。

people.name: Reza Abbasi
people.known_for: Painter of the Isfahan school famous for single-figure portraits of courtiers and youths.
people.known_for_zh: 伊斯法罕画派画家，以描绘朝臣与青年的单人肖像著称。

people.name: Mulla Sadra
people.known_for: Philosopher whose theory of the primacy of existence crowned Islamic philosophy in Iran.
people.known_for_zh: 哲学家，提出“存在优先”学说，是伊朗伊斯兰哲学的集大成者。

people.name: Saib Tabrizi
people.known_for: Poet laureate of Abbas II and master of the Indian style of Persian poetry.
people.known_for_zh: 阿拔斯二世的桂冠诗人，波斯诗歌“印度风格”的代表。

people.name: Mohammad-Baqer Majlesi
people.known_for: Chief Shia cleric of late Safavid Iran who compiled a huge collection of Shia traditions.
people.known_for_zh: 萨法维晚期的首席什叶派教士，编纂了卷帙浩繁的什叶派圣训集。

people.name: Jean Chardin
people.known_for: French jeweller whose account of his years in Isfahan is the best European picture of Safavid Iran.
people.known_for_zh: 法国珠宝商，记述了他在伊斯法罕多年的见闻，是欧洲人描写萨法维伊朗的最佳著作。

people.name: Mirwais Hotak
people.known_for: Pashtun chief who freed Kandahar from Safavid rule in 1709.
people.known_for_zh: 普什图部落首领，1709年使坎大哈摆脱萨法维王朝统治。

Persia.name: Nader Shah
Persia.note_zh: 阿夫沙尔王朝的建立者。

Persia.name: Karim Khan Zand
Persia.note: Founder of the Zand dynasty; never took the title of shah.
Persia.note_zh: 赞德王朝的建立者，始终未称沙。

Persia.name: Agha Mohammad Khan Qajar
Persia.note: Founder of the Qajar dynasty, crowned in 1796.
Persia.note_zh: 恺加王朝的建立者，1796年加冕。

people.name: Nader Shah
people.known_for: Soldier who drove out the Afghans and Ottomans, made himself shah and sacked Delhi in 1739.
people.known_for_zh: 出身行伍，赶走阿富汗人和奥斯曼人，自立为沙，1739年攻掠德里。

people.name: Ahmad Shah Durrani
people.known_for: Officer of Nader Shah who founded the Durrani Empire, the start of modern Afghanistan.
people.known_for_zh: 纳迪尔沙的部将，建立杜兰尼王朝，被视为现代阿富汗的奠基者。

people.name: Karim Khan Zand
people.known_for: Ruler who gave Iran thirty years of peace and adorned Shiraz with a bazaar, mosque and citadel.
people.known_for_zh: 统治者，使伊朗获得约三十年和平，在设拉子修建市场、清真寺和城堡。

people.name: Mirza Mahdi Khan Astarabadi
people.known_for: Secretary and historian of Nader Shah, who wrote the official account of his reign.
people.known_for_zh: 纳迪尔沙的秘书和史官，撰写了其统治时期的官方史书。

people.name: Hazin Lahiji
people.known_for: Persian poet and scholar who fled to India after the fall of Isfahan and wrote a memoir of his times.
people.known_for_zh: 波斯诗人和学者，伊斯法罕陷落后流亡印度，写下记述时代的回忆录。

people.name: Azar Bigdeli
people.known_for: Poet and anthologist whose collection of poets' lives helped start the Persian literary revival.
people.known_for_zh: 诗人和诗选编者，其诗人传记集推动了波斯文学复兴运动。

people.name: Hatef Esfahani
people.known_for: Poet of the literary return movement, famous for a mystical strophic poem.
people.known_for_zh: 文学复古运动的诗人，以一首神秘主义分节诗闻名。

people.name: Lotf Ali Khan
people.known_for: Last Zand ruler, a brave young king captured at Kerman by Agha Mohammad Khan.
people.known_for_zh: 赞德王朝末代君主，勇武的年轻国王，在克尔曼被阿迦·穆罕默德汗俘获。

people.name: Agha Mohammad Khan Qajar
people.known_for: Founder of the Qajar dynasty, who reunited Iran and made Tehran the capital.
people.known_for_zh: 恺加王朝的建立者，重新统一伊朗，定都德黑兰。

people.name: Abbas Mirza
people.known_for: Crown prince who led the wars against Russia and began Iran's first modern army and printing press.
people.known_for_zh: 恺加王储，领导对俄战争，开办伊朗最早的新式军队和印刷所。

people.name: Dost Mohammad Khan
people.known_for: Emir of Afghanistan who survived the First Anglo-Afghan War and reunited the country.
people.known_for_zh: 阿富汗埃米尔，历经第一次英阿战争，重新统一了阿富汗。

people.name: Amir Kabir
people.known_for: Reforming chief minister of Naser al-Din Shah who founded the Dar ul-Funun college.
people.known_for_zh: 纳赛尔丁沙的改革派首相，创办伊朗第一所新式学校“多科技术学院”。

people.name: The Báb
people.known_for: Merchant of Shiraz who founded the Babi movement and was executed in Tabriz.
people.known_for_zh: 设拉子商人，创立巴孛教运动，在大不里士被处决。

people.name: Táhirih
people.known_for: Poet and Babi leader who appeared unveiled in 1848 and was executed for her faith.
people.known_for_zh: 女诗人和巴孛教领袖，1848年当众摘下面纱，因信仰被处死。

people.name: Bahá'u'lláh
people.known_for: Founder of the Bahá'í Faith, who wrote its scriptures in exile in Baghdad and Acre.
people.known_for_zh: 巴哈伊教的创始人，在流放巴格达和阿卡期间写成该教经典。

people.name: Naser al-Din Shah Qajar
people.known_for: Qajar shah for nearly fifty years, the first to visit Europe, assassinated in 1896.
people.known_for_zh: 在位近五十年的恺加国王，首位访问欧洲的伊朗君主，1896年遇刺身亡。

people.name: Mirza Shirazi
people.known_for: Leading Shia cleric whose 1891 ruling against tobacco forced the shah to cancel a British monopoly.
people.known_for_zh: 什叶派最高宗教权威，1891年发布禁烟令，迫使国王取消英国烟草专卖权。

people.name: Abdur Rahman Khan
people.known_for: Iron Emir who built a centralised Afghan state within borders agreed with Britain and Russia.
people.known_for_zh: “铁腕埃米尔”，在与英俄议定的边界内建立中央集权的阿富汗国家。

people.name: Kamal-ol-molk
people.known_for: Court painter who brought European realism to Iran and founded a school of fine arts.
people.known_for_zh: 宫廷画家，把欧洲写实画风引入伊朗，创办美术学校。

people.name: Sattar Khan
people.known_for: Leader of the defence of Tabriz in the Constitutional Revolution, hailed as the national commander.
people.known_for_zh: 立宪革命中领导大不里士保卫战的领袖，被誉为“民族统帅”。

check.n: Was 1868; Wikipedia and Wikidata give 20 October 1866.
check.n_zh: 原作1868年，据维基百科与维基数据改为1866年。

people.name: Mirza Kuchik Khan
people.known_for: Leader of the Jungle Movement in Gilan against foreign intervention and the central government.
people.known_for_zh: 吉兰“丛林运动”的领袖，反对外国干涉和中央政府。

Iran.name: Reza Shah
Iran.note: Forced to abdicate by Britain and the Soviet Union.
Iran.note_zh: 被英国和苏联迫使退位。

people.name: Reza Shah
people.known_for: Cossack officer who founded the Pahlavi dynasty and pushed rapid modernisation from above.
people.known_for_zh: 哥萨克旅军官出身，建立巴列维王朝，自上而下推行快速现代化。

people.name: Ali-Akbar Dehkhoda
people.known_for: Satirist and linguist who compiled the largest dictionary of the Persian language.
people.known_for_zh: 讽刺作家和语言学家，编纂了规模最大的波斯语词典。

people.name: Mohammad Mosaddegh
people.known_for: Prime minister who nationalised Iran's oil industry and was overthrown in the 1953 coup.
people.known_for_zh: 伊朗首相，推动石油国有化，1953年在政变中被推翻。

people.name: Mohammad-Taqi Bahar
people.known_for: Poet laureate and scholar who wrote patriotic verse and a history of Persian prose style.
people.known_for_zh: 桂冠诗人和学者，写作爱国诗篇，著有波斯散文文体史。

people.name: Nima Yooshij
people.known_for: Father of modern Persian poetry, who broke with classical metre and rhyme.
people.known_for_zh: 现代波斯诗歌之父，打破了古典格律和韵脚的束缚。

check.n: Was 1897; Wikipedia and Wikidata give 11 November 1895.
check.n_zh: 原作1897年，据维基百科与维基数据改为1895年。

people.name: Sadegh Hedayat
people.known_for: Founder of modern Persian fiction, whose dark novella The Blind Owl is his masterpiece.
people.known_for_zh: 现代波斯小说的开创者，代表作是阴郁的中篇小说《盲枭》。

people.name: Parvin E'tesami
people.known_for: Poet whose moral debates and fables in classical form made her Iran's best-known woman poet of her time.
people.known_for_zh: 女诗人，以古典诗体写作道德辩论诗和寓言诗，是当时伊朗最著名的女诗人。

people.name: Mohammad Zahir Shah
people.known_for: Last king of Afghanistan, whose forty-year reign brought a 1964 constitution and relative peace.
people.known_for_zh: 阿富汗末代国王，在位四十年，颁布1964年宪法，国家相对安定。

people.name: Simin Daneshvar
people.known_for: First major Iranian woman novelist; her novel Savushun is a best-selling Persian novel.
people.known_for_zh: 伊朗第一位重要的女小说家，其《萨巫颂》是最畅销的波斯语小说之一。

people.name: Jalal Al-e-Ahmad
people.known_for: Writer whose essay Westoxification attacked Iran's blind imitation of the West.
people.known_for_zh: 作家，其论著《西化之毒》抨击伊朗盲目模仿西方。

people.name: Ahmad Shamlou
people.known_for: Leading modern poet who wrote free verse and compiled a vast encyclopedia of Persian folklore.
people.known_for_zh: 现代诗坛领袖，写作自由诗，并编纂大型波斯民俗百科《胡同之书》。

people.name: Forough Farrokhzad
people.known_for: Poet and film-maker whose frank modern verse made her the most famous Iranian woman poet.
people.known_for_zh: 诗人和电影导演，以坦率的现代诗成为最著名的伊朗女诗人。

people.name: Ali Shariati
people.known_for: Sociologist whose revolutionary reading of Shia Islam inspired the 1979 revolution.
people.known_for_zh: 社会学家，他对什叶派伊斯兰教的革命性诠释启发了1979年革命。

people.name: Ruhollah Khomeini
people.known_for: Shia cleric who led the 1979 revolution and founded the Islamic Republic as its first Supreme Leader.
people.known_for_zh: 什叶派宗教领袖，领导1979年革命，建立伊斯兰共和国并任首位最高领袖。

people.name: Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani
people.known_for: Cleric and president from 1989 to 1997 who led Iran's rebuilding after the war with Iraq.
people.known_for_zh: 教士政治家，1989年至1997年任总统，主持两伊战争后的重建。

people.name: Mohammad-Reza Shajarian
people.known_for: Master singer of Persian classical music, loved across Iran for his voice.
people.known_for_zh: 波斯古典音乐的歌唱大师，其歌声深受伊朗人喜爱。

people.name: Abbas Kiarostami
people.known_for: Film director whose Taste of Cherry won the Palme d'Or in 1997.
people.known_for_zh: 电影导演，其《樱桃的滋味》获1997年戛纳金棕榈奖。

people.name: Dariush Mehrjui
people.known_for: Director whose film The Cow started the Iranian New Wave in cinema.
people.known_for_zh: 电影导演，其《奶牛》开启了伊朗电影新浪潮。

people.name: Ahmad Shah Massoud
people.known_for: Afghan commander, the Lion of Panjshir, who fought the Soviets and the Taliban and was killed in 2001.
people.known_for_zh: 阿富汗指挥官，人称“潘杰希尔雄狮”，先后抗击苏军和塔利班，2001年遇刺身亡。

people.name: Mohammad Najibullah
people.known_for: Last communist president of Afghanistan, killed by the Taliban when they took Kabul.
people.known_for_zh: 阿富汗最后一位共产党政权总统，塔利班攻占喀布尔时被杀。

people.name: Qasem Soleimani
people.known_for: Commander of the Quds Force who directed Iran's allied militias abroad, killed by a US strike in 2020.
people.known_for_zh: 伊朗圣城旅指挥官，主导伊朗在海外的盟友武装，2020年被美军空袭击毙。

people.name: Maryam Mirzakhani
people.known_for: Iranian mathematician who became the first woman to win the Fields Medal, in 2014.
people.known_for_zh: 伊朗数学家，2014年成为首位获得菲尔兹奖的女性。

people.name: Ebrahim Raisi
people.known_for: Cleric and judge who became president in 2021 and died in a helicopter crash in 2024.
people.known_for_zh: 教士和法官出身，2021年当选总统，2024年死于直升机坠毁事故。
